entries.proposition: Hyperoxia was applied at 80 to 85 percent oxygen for 48 hours.
entries.snippet: Mice in the hyperoxia group, along with a lactating foster dam, were transferred into a transparent plastic chamber maintained with 80–85% of oxygen (O2) for 48 h.

entries.proposition: Pups received three subcutaneous injections of SB216763 at P6, P7 and P8.
entries.snippet: Pups received three subcutaneous injections of SB216763 (SB; Sigma-Aldrich) at P6, P7, and P8.

entries.proposition: The SB216763 dose the paper used was 15 mg/kg against a DMSO/PEG vehicle.
entries.snippet: Mice were treated with either vehicle (DMSO/PEG in saline) or SB216763 (15 mg/kg).

entries.proposition: The inhibitor was given before the hyperoxia exposure at P6, and the authors conclude it prevented the injury.
entries.snippet: we administered SB216763 (SB), a GSK3β-specific inhibitor, before hyperoxia exposure at P6
entries.anchor: Results / Pharmacological GSK3β inhibition prevents HO-induced alterations in progenitor cell and neuronal development

entries.proposition: Tamoxifen to delete the floxed kinase gene was injected at P4, 48 hours before hyperoxia.
entries.snippet: tamoxifen was injected at P4, 48 h before HO exposure
entries.anchor: Results / GSK3β ablation in hippocampal interneurons

entries.proposition: The legend of the electrophysiology figure lists three groups: control, hyperoxia, and hyperoxia plus SB.
entries.snippet: Normalized cumulative probability plots showing control (blue), HO (red), and HO + SB (dashed magenta) changes in IPSC amplitude (E)
entries.anchor: Figure legend of the P60 electrophysiology figure

entries.proposition: The text states that hyperoxia increased EPSC amplitude and frequency in CA1 and that SB reversed this.
entries.snippet: On the other hand, HO led to increased amplitude and frequency of EPSCs in the CA1, which was reversed by SB
entries.anchor: Results / Pharmacological GSK3β inhibition prevents HO-induced alterations to inhibitory neurotransmission

entries.proposition: After hyperoxia the authors observed reduced expression of BDNF, TrkB and Wnt, Akt and PI3K signalling components.
entries.snippet: following exposure to HO, we observed reduced expression of BDNF and its receptor TrkB, along with Wnt, Akt, and PI3K signaling components

entries.proposition: The authors conclude that GSK3 beta activation in Gad65 interneurons, rather than in POMC granule cells, mediates the memory deficit.
entries.snippet: aberrant activation of GSK3β in Gad65-expressing interneurons, rather than in POMC-expressing newly born granule cells, plays a significant role
entries.anchor: Results / GSK3β ablation in hippocampal interneurons
